market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global chip conveyor market: $1,322M (2024) to $1,818M by 2031 (~4.6%/yr) per one source; $1.82B (2025) to $3.14B by 2034 (6.2%/yr) per another. Global coolant filtration systems market: $2.9B (2025) to $7.3B by 2036 (8.7%/yr, 2026-2036); coolant filtration cartridge modules growing 7-9%/yr (2026-2035). India-specific chip-conveyor/coolant-filtration market size was not found.
exportGeographies: not found beyond generic 'globally networked' self-description
market.domesticSlice: Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing/largest region for coolant filtration at ~7.1%/yr, vs. North America 5.8% and Europe 5.4%.

structureFacts: Machine-tool industry capex and automation in metal-cutting operations drives demand; higher machining automation and lights-out/unattended manufacturing increases reliance on automated swarf/chip/coolant handling
Semiconductor fab expansion is cited as a specific driver of coolant filtration system demand growth
OEM bundling: chip/coolant conveyor vendors increasingly integrate with machine-tool OEMs at the design stage rather than being purely aftermarket add-ons

adoptionStructure.note: Productivity/uptime (unattended chip removal enabling lights-out shifts), coolant recycling/cost savings, compliance with machine-tool OEM specs, and total filtration performance (fine particulate/tramp-oil removal affecting tool life and part quality) drive purchasing.
